subject: A cure with a side of corndog
body: You stabbed a villager with a syringe and spun his blood in a centrifuge until X-Genes fell out. He said "hrmm." Pretty sure that means thank you. Put them in an Oritech Assembler with an empty syringe, a Totem of Undying and a cooked corndog and boom, my Weapon X syringe. They tortured me for weeks for my healing factor and you get yours with a corndog. Im not mad. Im not. They just could've offered me a corndog.
